zh: 修复移动端发送消息流式回复丢失：序列化请求显式携带 stream 与 agent 参数并保障主线程按序刷新，发完即见完整回答与耗时 token。
修复模型切换半截裁剪与会话扫光骨架：重构 SwiftUI 模型菜单触发层避免文字裁剪，点击会话直接跳转聊天页并展示动态扫光骨架屏。
修复已归档会话标题与后台对齐：支持 snake_case 与首句提问/自动摘要标题解码，归档列表真实呈现原对话名称。
侧边栏打通 Agent 对话生态：移动端合并展示 Codex、Claude Code、Antigravity、WorkBuddy 桌面端连接器与工作区群聊会话，支持查看与续聊。
en: Fix missing streaming replies on mobile send: explicitly serialize stream and agent defaults with FIFO main-thread delivery so replies and token metadata render immediately.
Fix model switcher clipping & add chat shimmer skeleton: decouple SwiftUI label from UIKit menu animation and switch straight into a shimmer loading state when opening sessions.
Fix archived session titles in backend & mobile: return auto titles and first-question fallbacks and decode snake_case archive metadata instead of falling back to generic placeholders.
Unify Agent conversations in mobile sidebar: merge Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, WorkBuddy, workspace agent, and group discussions with provider badges and interactive replies.
